description: Test suite for gateway constants functions and configuration, validating profile normalization, service name resolution, task naming, and description formatting for different profiles and environments.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayProfile
methods.description: Normalizes a given Gateway profile string, trimming whitespace and returning null for default or empty profiles.

methods.name: resolveGatewayLaunchAgentLabel
methods.description: Determines the launch agent label based on the profile, defaulting if no profile is set.

methods.name: resolveGatewaySystemdServiceName
methods.description: Generates the systemd service name based on the profile, with a default fallback.

methods.name: resolveGatewayWindowsTaskName
methods.description: Generates the Windows task scheduler name based on the profile.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProfileSuffix
methods.description: Returns a suffix string for the profile, used in naming conventions, with special handling for default profiles.

methods.name: formatGatewayServiceDescription
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for the Gateway service, including optional profile and version information.

methods.name: resolveGatewayServiceDescription
methods.description: Resolves the service description string, prioritizing explicit override or deriving from environment variables and context.
